_comment: Shared parity fixture for T795: the JS foldPlaceName (weatherServiceAdapters.js) and the Python fold_place_name (chronos_timezone_data.py) are one rule - fold a place name so two spellings of it meet - and they had drifted into three implementations. The settings completion list folded with strip/lower/replace('_',' '), so it would not offer 'São Paulo' for a typed 'Sao' nor 'Saint-Étienne' for 'saint etienne', while the runtime geocode matcher folded both: the user was shown a narrower set of suggestions than the thing that would actually answer accepts. weather_adapters.test.js and test_settings_widgets_specialized.py each assert this table, so a one-sided change fails one suite. The cache key (weatherProviders.locationCacheKey) is deliberately NOT this rule and is not in here: Genova and Génova are two cities, and folding them onto one key would make one geocode answer for the other.

and two names that merely look alike are still two names
